Footnotes.LaterMincha: When a halachic day is less than 12 hours, some wait a full 30 minutes after Chatzot.
Footnotes.MenorahLighting: The menorah must burn for at least 30 minutes after nightfall. Therefore, you must ensure that the menorah will burn from the time they are kindled until at least 30 minutes after nightfall.
